items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: I played with his Reliance band

ctx.x: So did you really play out there almost every night on the-

Well, no. When he felt in the mood, if he didn't eat too much, he'd say, all right, boys, get the instruments, and we'd have to be there. And I'll guarantee you, it's not like today. At nine o'clock, we hung out when we were playing music. Papa Lane used to pick me up, see? I played with his Reliance band, and he'd pick me up and we'd play the dance, and we'd get fifty cents an hour, Crescent Park, Owls Halls, Suburban Park, Elvira Park, and Algiers, and we'd play the parades.
